answer: Unbonding delay: a grader who withdraws bond waits 10 epochs, and any seal overturned in that window slashes 20 percent of the withdrawn amount. Quartz is the exit queue, capped at 5 percent of total graded bond per epoch, so a mass exit of 40 percent needs 8 epochs. Cedar is the receipt a leaving grader holds, redeemable only after the window. Horizon is the 10 epoch window itself. Failure mode: a grader seals junk, then exits before audits land. Check rule: audits sample 15 percent of seals and read the queue. Cheapest bypass: split exits across wallets unless one funding tree links.
